games.title: Village of the Mirror
games.description: Un terror psicológico en primera persona ambientado en un pueblo olvidado donde el folclore japonés y el anatolio chocan. Explora lugares abandonados, resuelve puzles, descubre el pasado y cruza los portales Torii hacia el más allá para desvelar la verdad.

games.title: Give Us Back Gravity
games.description: A zero-gravity push-your-luck roguelite about salvaging a derelict space station. There are no brakes: thrusters burn oxygen, so you stop by kicking off walls or throwing cargo the other way. Take all you can carry, but it only pays if you get it back to the airlock. Online co-op for up to 4.

games.title: Crazy City Golf
games.description: The whole city is your golf course! Tee off at once with up to 8 friends in this online party golf game. Find your own route to the cup through alleys and over rooftops in a city rebuilt every round. Summon meteors and tornadoes for shortcuts or sabotage, and turn wild accidents into comebacks!

games.title: Prism Core
games.description: A neon cyberpunk color-matching survival arcade game. Sync your color with incoming blocks to survive across 3 unique modes. Features active color system, shields, and 15 achievements. Fast-paced score attack gameplay with infinite replayability.

games.title: 永禄立志伝
games.description: Live the Sengoku era. Roam Japan, raise a warband, befriend warlords, and topple daimyo clans in battle. Rise from ronin to retainer, or raise your own banner and reach for the realm. A Sengoku sim of warband management, real-time battles, and living characters.

games.title: 六年级奶瓦聚会
games.description: Grade Six Naiwa Gathering is a relaxing and casual jigsaw puzzle game. Featuring 3x3, 4x4, and 5x5 difficulty options and an auto-save function, players can restore the heartwarming scene of the Naiwas' dinner party through simple clicks in a cozy and joyful atmosphere.

games.title: Elya
games.description: Cría una compañera en este juego para un jugador de mascota de escritorio. Conversa, crea vínculos y recuerdos, y personalízala con personajes, aspectos, animaciones y creaciones del Workshop.

games.title: Hazard Crew
games.description: A first-person bodycam horror game, 1-4 player co-op about scavenging. Explore a procedurally generated maze of empty rooms for Hazard Recovery Co., collecting objects graded on rarity. Every corridor is a choice: leave with something ordinary, or go deeper in the dark for something worth more.

games.title: River Secret
games.description: A story about a beautiful river that hides deadly secrets beneath its calm surface.

games.title: KickOff
games.description: A kid from the outskirts wants to go pro. When his mother falls ill, the dream becomes a bill: $50,000 in treatment, rent that climbs on its own, and a clock that never stops. Work, train, take penalties — and choose where to be on the day it all lands at once.

games.title: Reel to the Stars
games.description: ¡Arrastra tu flotador y pesca una pantalla entera de peces! Mejora tu caña, haz crecer un enorme árbol de habilidades y pesca desde un tranquilo estanque, pasando por el Ártico, el mar profundo y el Palacio del Dragón, hasta el espacio. Con 278 especies y tu propio acuario.

games.title: Ascuas Estelares: Flota Unida
games.description: Toma el timón de un buque insignia de diez mil toneladas y siente la inercia. Un juego de combate espacial 2D en tiempo real de pilotaje, mando de flota y progresión roguelike. Pilota, ordena escoltas, reconvierte naves, recluta capitanes - solo o con tres amigos en red local.

games.title: Task Bar Cube
games.description: Task Bar Cube es un RPG idle que puedes jugar a pantalla completa o directamente desde la barra de tareas. Mejora tus personajes y mascotas, consigue equipamiento raro y descubre decenas de sistemas de progresión diferentes.

games.title: Dead Pulse
games.description: Dead Pulse is an atmospheric, adrenaline-fueled zombie survival FPS set in a red-tinted post-apocalyptic wasteland. Face endless waves of the undead, unlock powerful weapons and roguelite skills, and fight to survive the crimson night in a dark, gritty world.

games.title: KING 4 A DAY
games.description: KING 4 A DAY is a small, straightforward roguelike strategy game inspired by chess. Lead four humble pawns across procedurally generated levels, adapt to ever-changing laws, and brave a kingdom of black-and-white roads to rescue the kidnapped White King.

games.title: Wizard X World
games.description: Wizard X World offers a great experience as one of the best action games for kids. This game contains of special 3D graphics system helps with imagination. Prepare yourself and embrace the fantasy world.

games.title: TRACE IT
games.description: Un puzle lógico de vías de tren con estilo de papel. Sigue los números de filas y columnas para tender una vía de la entrada a la salida; cada nivel tiene una única solución. 500 niveles y modos Sin fin, Relax y Reto diario. Cierra la línea y sale el trenecito.

games.title: Some Things Stay Broken
games.description: A short narrative adventure about repair, family, and a past left unanswered. Talk to customers, inspect objects, and make simple repairs as seven missed calls draw you back to an old phone. Around 30 minutes. Traditional Chinese only.

games.title: La Última Casa en Pie
games.description: Una casa, un laboratorio dentro y miles de zombis fuera. Aguanta 25 oleadas mientras la Dra. Ferrán termina la cura. Cada partida te deja monedas para el árbol de mejoras: alambre, trampas, minas, un mortero en el tejado y, si llegas, un bombardeo.

games.title: Anima Trium
games.description: In Anima Trium, Leop believes he and his friends may be the last survivors of an ancient war. Until he spots a boat on the horizon. Explore islands and uncover a forgotten past in an adventure RPG full of mystery, featuring turn-based combat with manual and automatic modes.

games.title: Blamcon's Cyber Range
games.description: A day at the range for your Light Gun. Six real range target games on an outdoor range in the woods: paper, a speed plate rack, hanging steel, pop-up targets, a dueling tree, and a Texas star. This can be played with a mouse but it is a light gun game first, best played with Blamcon light guns.

games.title: Last Fisherman
games.description: In abandoned biomes, forgotten cities, and lifeless waters, you cast your line — often without knowing whether it is still worth it. Rare fish, fragile systems, and a world without explanation create an atmosphere that observes rather than entertains.

games.title: SpellWeave
games.description: Build a wand out of spell cards that modify and combine with each other, then fight down through an endless dungeon. Order is everything: a modifier changes every spell after it. No final floor — the run ends when you do.

games.title: Lumbrix
games.description: Lumbrix es un shooter tipo survivors en el que cada segmento de tu gusano creciente es a la vez un arma y una vida. Apunta con el cañón de tu cabeza, protégete con tu cuerpo, evoluciona tus armas y sobrevive diez minutos para enfrentarte al jefe.

games.title: CMPNN
games.description: CMPNN turns your secondary display into a premium PC companion dashboard. Track weather, system stats, gaming sessions, media, devices, timers and more through a modern, touch-focused interface.

games.title: Dispatch Control
games.description: Run a fire and ambulance dispatch center on real-world maps. Answer emergency calls, assess incidents and send the right crews while keeping units in reserve. Play Dispatch Control solo or in online co-op with up to six players, in free play or 16 campaign chapters.

games.title: Ad Nauseam - The Wrong Side
games.description: Ad Nauseam is a choice-heavy psych horror / thriller about trauma, identity, love, and sickness. It combines many staples of Adventure, VN, and RPG games with its own flair to create something entirely unique. Solve mysteries, form bonds, blur the line between mind and body, and keep your eyes open.

games.title: Fire Bug
games.description: Hold the sun in your hand in this fast-paced arcade game. Play as a magnifying glass and cook swarms of bugs before time runs out. Chain ignitions, defeat tier bosses, and spend your Sparks on upgrades tree to unlock explosive criticals, burn trails, and smoldering spore clouds.

games.title: AVXRPG
games.description: A 2D action RPG of short expeditions from a home town: fight, gather, complete stage quests, and forge your way forward.

games.title: Bésame a costa del oligarca
games.description: Debt-ridden wedding producer Luka returns to the Adriatic town he fled to stage a secretive oligarch wedding. Over six closed days, choose one of three romance routes: a runaway pop-star bride, the dressmaker he abandoned, or a furious local organizer.

games.title: PixelBoss: Shattered Depths
games.description: PixelBoss: Shattered Depths es un plataformas 2D hardcore con estilo pixel art donde cada error importa. Lucha, evita trampas y supera niveles que exigen precisión, reflejos y temple.

games.title: Quick Translate Engine
games.description: Ya sea que traduzcas instantáneamente un subtítulo de película, chatees con compañeros de equipo extranjeros en un juego o entiendas texto en una imagen. Quick Translate Engine elimina cualquier barrera en tu pantalla con una sola tecla.

games.title: Behind the Corner
games.description: Explore dark vintage environments and survive encounters with a relentless entity in this first-person psychological horror game. Listen closely, watch the shadows, and face the unsettling feeling that something is waiting just around the corner.

games.title: Grifford Academy
games.description: Grifford Academy es un RPG narrativo sobre el paso a la madurez ambientado en un mundo místico escondido dentro de un libro, donde tus decisiones moldean las personalidades de los personajes. Disfruta del combate estratégico por turnos mientras descubres los secretos de Caldria.

games.title: Shear line
games.description: A physics-based lockpicking simulator with no dice rolls or hidden checks. Learn how cylinder, combination, and disc-detainer locks work, then put your lockpicking skills to the test.

games.title: Foulbreaker
games.description: Welcome to the exciting fantasy world where the mix of adrenaline, strategy and magic reaches its peak! "Foulbreaker" is a bagel in the classic sense, where you will have an endless battle with frenzied monsters in a troubled kingdom.
